common:generalComment.#text: Hot rolled steel is a type of steel that is formed using the hot rolling process at a temperature above its recrystallization temperature. It is easier to shape at this elevated temperature and typically does not require any post-forming heat treatment. It is processed at high temperatures, improving malleability and strength. Due to the higher temperatures, hot-rolled steel is much more workable than cold-rolled steel, making it suitable for applications requiring complex shapes.
热轧钢是一种通过在其再结晶温度以上的温度下进行热轧工艺形成的钢。在这种较高的温度下，它更容易塑形，通常不需要任何后期成型热处理。它在高温下处理，提高了延展性和强度。由于温度较高，热轧钢比冷轧钢更易加工，使其适用于需要复杂形状的应用。

common:synonyms.#text: Demineralized water; DI water; Deionized H2O

common:generalComment.#text: Deionised water is water that has had its ions removed. It is produced through a process that filters out minerals and ions such as calcium, sodium, iron, copper, chloride, and bromide. It has no set standard compliance but is often produced to meet specific quality criteria required for certain industrial or laboratory processes. Deionised water is typically used in applications where the presence of ions may interfere with machinery, experiments, or manufacturing processes, such as in cooling applications, laboratory tests, or electronics manufacturing. The production route involves ion exchange, reverse osmosis, or distillation. The product may be supplied as part of a production or consumption mix and is available at the production plant or to the consumer.
去离子水是通过去除了其离子的水。它通过过滤掉矿物质及离子如钙、钠、铁、铜、氯化物和溴化物的过程产生。它没有设定的标准遵从性，但通常生产出来以满足某些工业或实验室过程所需的特定质量标准。去离子水通常应用于离子存在可能干扰机械、实验或制造过程的地方，例如在冷却应用、实验室测试或电子制造中。其生产路线包括离子交换、反渗透或蒸馏。该产品可能作为生产或消费混合物供应，且可在生产工厂或消费者那里获得。

common:synonyms.#text: activated charcoal; active carbon; activated carbon

common:generalComment.#text: Activated carbon, also called activated charcoal, is a form of carbon used to filter contaminants from water and air. It is processed to have small, low-volume pores that increase the surface area for adsorption or chemical reactions. It is typically made from wood, but can also be made using bamboo, coconut husk, peat, woods, coir, lignite, coal, pitch, and other dense carbon sources. It is a rough, imperfectly structured kind of graphite with a wide spectrum of pores of varying sizes.
活性炭又称活性炭，是一种用于过滤水和空气中污染物的碳。经过加工，活性炭具有小而体积小的孔隙，从而增加了吸附或化学反应的表面积。它通常由木材制成，但也可以用竹子、椰子壳、泥炭、木材、椰壳纤维、褐煤、煤、沥青和其他致密碳源制成。它是一种结构粗糙、不完美的石墨，具有大小不一的各种孔隙。
